newsitem.title: USA: Zurn unit gets $75 mln in contracts.
newsitem.headline: Zurn unit gets $75 mln in contracts.

text.p: Zurn Industries Inc said Tuesday its Advanco Constructors unit has been awarded contracts totaling $75 million for projects in Southern California.

The largest contract is with the Metropolitan Water District for a $62.2 million project to construct a 16,000 gallon per second pumping station at the termination of the nine-mile-long, 12-foot-diameter Eastside Pipeline, also built by Advanco.
Work on the pumping station will begin in January, with completion planned for the spring of 1999.

Advanco has also been awarded contracts by the Orange County Sanitation District for an ocean outfall facility upgrade, by the City of Long Beach for storm drains, and by Orange County Environmental Management for excavation and shoring of the Talbert Channel.
